en-US.title: Agentbox
en-US.subtitle: Reply to your coding agents
en-US.promoText: Read what your agents did, answer the ones waiting on you, and start new work from your phone.
en-US.description:
Agentbox is an inbox for the coding agents you run with Claude Code and Codex. The iPhone app shows the threads that need you, in the same order as Agentbox on your computer.

Read an agent's answer, with the pictures, films and pages it made. Reply, pick one of the options it offers, or allow or deny what it asks to run. Start a new thread in any project. Put a thread off until later, or close it.

Your agents run on your own Claude or ChatGPT account, on your computer or in Agentbox Cloud. Alerts tell you when a thread needs you, and you can dictate a reply instead of typing it.

Agentbox for iPhone signs in to the account you make in Agentbox on your computer. Download it at agentbox.ac.
en-US.releaseNotes: The first version on the App Store.

review.notes:
Agentbox for iPhone is the phone side of Agentbox, a desktop app for macOS and Linux that runs AI coding agents (Claude Code by Anthropic and Codex by OpenAI) on the user's own subscription. The phone shows the user's threads with their agents, and lets them reply, answer an agent's permission requests and start new threads.

DEMO ACCOUNT
Sign in on the first screen with the email and password in the Sign-In Information fields. Nothing else is needed: no computer and no other login. We keep a computer signed in to this account running for the whole review, the way a user's own computer would be, so every reply and new thread is answered. An answer takes one to three minutes. Continue with Apple or Google with your own ID makes a new, empty account, which waits for a computer of its own as a new user's would; the demo login shows the app at work.

WHAT TO TRY
1. Open a thread under Needs you and read the agent's answer. Tap a picture it names to open it.
2. Reply to it and wait for the answer. If you turn on alerts, one arrives when it is ready.
3. Tap the pen to start a new thread in the demo project.
4. Settings, then General: where your messages go, the privacy policy, Help, and Delete account.

WHERE MESSAGES GO (5.1.2(i))
Before the first message, the app names the companies that receive it (Anthropic or OpenAI, on the user's own account) and asks for an explicit yes. "Not now, I'll just read" leaves the app read-only, and Settings, then General turns it off again.

PURCHASES (3.1)
The app sells nothing, unlocks nothing, and shows no prices, plans or links to buy. It works fully with the user's own computer at no cost.

REPORTING AN ANSWER (1.2)
The More button at the top of every thread has Report this thread, which sends the thread and the answer reported to the team with the user's words. A person reads every report within a working day. What an agent writes is visible only to the account that ran it, and Claude Code and Codex apply Anthropic's and OpenAI's own safety systems and usage policies to everything they write. Pages an agent makes open without running their code, and their links open in Safari, not in the app.

ACCOUNTS (5.1.1(v))
Accounts are made in Agentbox on the computer, and the phone signs in to them with email and password, Sign in with Apple, or Google. Sign in with Apple is offered wherever Google is. Delete account in Settings, then General deletes the account and everything it put online.

NOT A REMOTE DESKTOP (4.2.7)
The app has its own native screens over the user's account. It does not show, mirror or control a computer's screen.

CONTACT
Agents' output is private to the account that ran them. Settings, then General, then Send feedback reaches the team, and Help gives an email address.
